images.prompt: Natural architectural photograph of one simple wooden bench in front of a gently curved pale concrete wall. The bench runs horizontally across the lower center with two dark legs visible. A narrow diagonal shadow crosses the floor from upper left, and a small patch of grass appears at far right. Soft afternoon daylight, eye-level view. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. Complete composition with breathing room. Natural photography and realistic light; no text, logo, watermark, or existing graphic treatment.

review.reason: Natural architectural photograph with a complete one-seat/two-support bench, coherent curved wall, paving and soft cast shadows. The core bench is uncut and unbranded; continuous wall and landscape are appropriate scene context.

images.actual_source_analysis: One long simple bench extends horizontally across the lower middle of the image. It has a single thick honey-brown wooden seat with visible grain and two dark rectangular metal supports beneath the left and right ends. The full bench is visible and stands on a gray concrete paved surface. A tall pale curved concrete wall fills the background, bending away toward the right; construction seams and small round tie holes are visible. Soft leafy shadows fall across the left wall and paving. Blue sky occupies the upper right, with a narrow grassy strip at far right. No people, logos, writing or existing grid graphic are visible.

Maintain clear separation between adjacent subjects, support surfaces, background, and shadows through changes in grid direction and density.
Balance tight optical passages with calm open regions so the source remains readable at thumbnail size.
Allow local grid bending, compression, and stretching inside forms; keep silhouettes, support points, and major boundaries fixed.
